0.text:
Greetings, hero!

Is this your first time in #cMapleStory#?
Or perhaps you're returning to your adventure after a long rest!
We've prepared a #cCharacter Creation Guide#
to aid you in choosing your world and job.

1.text:
Would you like to #ccheck out the Character Creation Guide#?


* This event is #cpurely informational# and does not have a completion reward.
* You can quit the guide with the #cESC key# at any time.

0.text:
#cMapleStory# is made up of several worlds that offer unique benefits. Hover over the #cHeroic# and #cInteractive# categories for more information.
Of course, there's always #cCross World Auction House & Meso Market#,
and #cCross World Bosses#, where characters from different worlds can trade and team up.

Select which world you would like to start your adventure in!

1.text:
For a speedy leveling experience, try #cmaking a character# in a #cChallenger World#!

#cChallenger Worlds# are limited-time worlds that have many #clevel-up perks#.
There are also #cspecial events# and a #cboss#
only available in Challenger Worlds.

#c·  Challenger World Level Up Period  ·#
11/11/2026 (Wed) - 02/09/2027 (Tue) 23:59 PM UTC

2.text: #cChallenger Worlds# come in two types, #cChallenger-Heroic# and #cChallenger-Interactive#. Only #cnewly created characters# can access Challenger Worlds.\nMake sure you #cchoose# your world carefully!

3.text: Select the #cworld# you would like to create a character in.

0.text:
In the new event, #cHyper Burning MAX# characters will gain
#c4 additional levels# for each level they earn, until #cLv. 260#.

#cBeyond Burning# characters will gain #c1 extra level#
for each level they earn, from #cLv. 260# to #c280#.
Don't miss out!

#c[Burning Event Period]#
11/11/2026 (Wed) - 02/09/2027 (Tue) 23:59 PM UTC

1.text: Create a character by pressing the #cCreate Character# button.

0.text: MapleStory has various jobs under\nthe different classes: #cWarrior, Magician, Bowman, Thief, and Pirate#.\nConsider your preferred playstyle, and select the #cjob that fits you best#!

1.text: You can view detailed descriptions of each job\nfrom #cJob Info#, including the #cjob description, origin, movement type, main stats#,\nand more, so be sure to check them out.

2.text: #cLethe#, the #cSovereign of Oaths#, has arrived in Maple World!\nCelebrate with an #cevent# for the #cnew character's# progression.\nDon't miss this chance to level up!

3.text: #cSelect the job# that best fits your playstyle\nand press the #cCreate Character# button to #cget started#!

0.text:
You're almost done!

Customize your character's #cgender, hair color, face#, and more,
then press the #cNext# button.

1.text:
Now, the moment of truth.

It's time to #cname your character#!
Press #cVerify# to #cconfirm# if your name is available.

2.text:
As soon as you press #cConfirm#, the current #ccharacter will be created#.

Please only #cproceed#
if you are sure you're ready to proceed.

3.text: Select which style of #ckey bindings# you'd like to use.\n\n#cDefault Key Bindings# are #crecommended# for players who are familiar with MapleStory.

4.text:
The #cSecondary Key Bindings# are recommended for players who are
familiar with other online games.

You can #cview the settings from the Preview#.

5.text: Select the #ckey bindings# you would like.

6.text:
You've made it to the end of the #cMapleStory character creation guide#.
We hope that it was helpful in #cmaking your brand new character#.

Are you ready to embark on your #cMaple World# adventure?

7.text:
This character can be designated as a #cHyper Burning MAX character#!

There are #clevel-up support rewards# only #cHyper Burning MAX characters# receive,
and a #cHyper Blink# event for ultra-speedy progression until #cLv. 260#!
We #crecommend# trying it out!

You can designate a character for Hyper Burning MAX #conce per account#.
